preconditions.description: The input list must contain exactly two elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(bear, str) for bear in bears)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input list must be strings.

postconditions.description: The output must be one of the specified bear fur colors or 'unknown'.
If both bears are black, the offspring must be black.
If both bears are brown, the offspring must be brown.
If both bears are white, the offspring must be white.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'dark brown' if set(bears) == {'black', 'brown'} else True
postconditions.description: If one bear is black and the other is brown, the offspring must be dark brown.
If one bear is black and the other is white, the offspring must be grey.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'light brown' if set(bears) == {'brown', 'white'} else True
postconditions.description: If one bear is brown and the other is white, the offspring must be light brown.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'unknown' if any(bear not in {'black', 'brown', 'white'} for bear in bears) else True
postconditions.description: If any bear is not black, brown, or white, the offspring must be unknown.
